item.title: Savannah Guthrie Seeks Answers About Mother Nancy After Notes Released
item.description: Savannah Guthrie said her family has been in "agony and despair" since her mother Nancy's disappearance in February.

item.title: U.S. investigates possible Iranian role in cyberattacks on Michigan, Minnesota utilities
item.description: Cyber incidents disrupted water systems in at least seven states this week, including Minnesota, prompting federal investigation.

item.title: Iran updates: Trump considers strikes on Iranian energy sites, officials say
item.description: President Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Trump blames Minnesota governor, not Iran, for cyberattacks on state's water systems
item.description: Trump attributed the cyberattacks on Minnesota's water systems to the state's Democratic governor.
